title: Random acceleration noise on Stern-Gerlach Interferometry in a Harmonic Trap
summary: We analyze decoherence in a one-loop Stern--Gerlach--type matter-wave interferometer for a massive nanoparticle embedded with a nitrogen vacancy (NV)-centered nanodiamond evolving under an effective harmonic-oscillator dynamics in a magnetic-field gradient. We assume that the Stern-Gerlach interferometer is subjected to an acceleration $\vec{a}$ external to the system, which is at an angle $θ_0$ with respect to the direction of the superposition.
